{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint analysis lacks handling of missing data",
      "quote": "Patients who are not evaluable for BOR will be considered as non-responders.",
      "page": 77,
      "section": "11.4.3.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary analysis defines non-evaluable patients as non-responders, but does not specify how missing data (e.g., due to COVID-19) will be handled beyond this, despite the statistical plan mentioning missing data due to COVID-19 will be specified in the SAP.",
      "fix": "Add explicit missing data handling rules for the primary endpoint, including sensitivity analyses."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoints lack detailed analysis methods",
      "quote": "median and its 95% confidence interval using the Kaplan-Meier method.",
      "page": 78,
      "section": "11.4.3.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The secondary efficacy analysis section only mentions median and CI for time-to-event endpoints, but does not describe how DOR, PFS, and OS will be analyzed (e.g., censoring rules, definitions of events).",
      "fix": "Provide complete analysis methods for each secondary endpoint, including censoring and event definitions."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exploratory biomarker endpoints lack analysis details",
      "quote": "Analysis of all other exploratory pharmacodynamic and baseline predictive biomarker data will be included in a separate biomarker analysis report.",
      "page": 79,
      "section": "11.4.7",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol defers analysis of most exploratory biomarker endpoints to a separate report, leaving no statistical methods specified in the protocol for these endpoints.",
      "fix": "Include at least a summary of planned statistical methods for exploratory biomarker analyses in the protocol."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint is ORR based on radiographic response, measured by RECIST version 1.1.",
      "page": 35,
      "section": "4.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary endpoint definition does not specify the estimand attributes: population (FAS is defined later), variable (BOR of CR/PR), intercurrent events (e.g., treatment discontinuation, death), and summary measure (proportion).",
      "fix": "Define the estimand for the primary endpoint including all attributes."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent definition of safety endpoint",
      "quote": "adverse events (SAEs) and ≥ grade 3 laboratory abnormalities during the treatment period and up to 90 days after the last dose of study treatment",
      "page": 35,
      "section": "4.2",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The secondary endpoint lists 'adverse events (SAEs)' but the safety analysis section mentions 'Treatment-emergent AEs/AESIs/SAEs', which is broader. The endpoint text may be incomplete.",
      "fix": "Clarify whether all AEs or only SAEs are included in the safety endpoint."
    },
    {
      "title": "No sample size justification provided",
      "quote": "This is a single arm, open label study and there is no formal statistical hypothesis in this study.",
      "page": 76,
      "section": "11.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not include a sample size section or justification, which is essential for a single-arm study to ensure precision of the ORR estimate.",
      "fix": "Add a sample size section with assumptions (e.g., expected ORR, confidence interval width) and justification."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for immunogenicity endpoint",
      "quote": "Cemiplimab immunogenicity as measured by anti-drug antibodies (ADA) to cemiplimab",
      "page": 35,
      "section": "4.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The immunogenicity endpoint is listed but no statistical analysis method is described in the statistical plan for ADA data.",
      "fix": "Add a subsection under statistical methods for immunogenicity analysis."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for HPV serotyping endpoint",
      "quote": "HPV serotyping of archival tumor",
      "page": 35,
      "section": "4.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The exploratory endpoint for HPV serotyping is listed but no analysis method is provided in the statistical plan.",
      "fix": "Specify how HPV serotyping data will be summarized or analyzed."
    }
  ]
}
